narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**1291 hits, 94 files.** Only the `services` ones are safe.

| zone | hits | rename | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `services/**` identifiers | ~1075 | yes | internal |
| repo SQL strings | 125 | no | live DB column |
| [`migrations/*.sql`](migrations/20250128_create_invoices.sql) | 61 | no | all applied |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | no | regenerated |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | no | public contract |
| [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js#L8) | 2 | no | wire name |

Two traps inside the safe zone. 25 repo files embed `account_id` in JSONB payloads. A blind rename changes stored data. 75 `audit()` calls would rename log fields.

Next: approve JS identifiers only, freeze the rest.
